text: なついてくれるので　いっしょに　あそびたがる　じょせいも　おおい。

structure.en: because it kindly grows attached to you

structure.jp: いっしょに　あそびたがる　じょせいも
structure.en: women who want to play with it, too

patterns.name: 〜たがる
patterns.explanation: たがる after a verb says someone else shows that they want to do it. あそびたがる = '(they) want to play'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる after a verb says someone does it and you are glad of it. なついてくれる = 'it kindly takes to you'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いっしょに　あそびたがる　じょせい
patterns.explanation: The words before じょせい describe which women they are. いっしょに　あそびたがる　じょせい = 'women who want to play with it'.
